verdict.rationale: Cognee's `.remember` operation automatically ingests raw text/files/URLs and extracts entities/relationships into a knowledge graph in one call, and `.improve` runs after ingestion to enrich the graph and bridge short-term session memory into permanent memory in the background (cognee-docs-16, cognee-docs-31, cognee-docs-38). This matches automatic extraction and background consolidation, but the pipeline still requires an explicit `.remember`/`.improve` invocation rather than the system autonomously deciding, unprompted, what raw conversation is worth storing, and there's no independent evidence of extraction/salience quality. Missing for 10: evidence of fully autonomous/unprompted triggering of memory writes, and independent validation of the quality of what gets extracted as 'salient'.
